Subject: Evidence request - new hire verification & training pack

Hi Diego,

Thanks for agreeing to help. As part of our vendor onboarding review for payroll integrations, Compliance is collecting evidence around employee verification and ongoing training for all vendor personnel who will access PII. Can you please provide the following by Friday 2026-04-24: 

- Sample redacted background check (for a real employee; SSNs and DOBs redacted)
- Training completion roster for the last 12 months (module names, completion dates, role)
- Current onboarding checklist showing identity verification steps and role assignment gates
- Offboarding playbook or checklist that covers credential revocation and data access removal
- Confirmation of any automated periodic re-checks or attestations (frequency)

We use this to complete our SOC2/SIG evidence pack. I attached our vendor intake form to indicate the fields we need. If anything above is sensitive and needs an alternate path (SFTP or VPN), let me know.

Appreciate it,
Samira Khan
Vendor Risk Analyst
Acme Payments
(attachment: acme_request_form.pdf)

Hi Samira — thanks for the clear list. Putting together the packet now. Quick notes and plan: 

- We'll provide a redacted background-check sample (no DOB/SSN/gov IDs) and the HR attestation that the vendor checks are performed via our third-party provider.
- Training roster: export from LMS with module IDs and completion timestamps; we'll include role mapping for those with access to PII scopes.
- Onboarding checklist and offboarding playbook: I'll attach our standard PDF checklists (onboarding-checklist-v2.pdf, offboarding-playbook-v1.pdf).
- Re-check cadence: we run role-based attestations annually and ad-hoc for role/privilege changes.

As this includes employee data, Monica (People Ops) — can you review the attached redaction and confirm we can share the sample? Rishi (Legal) — if HR needs to route this through an alternate secure transfer, please advise.

Target: share final ZIP with redacted artifacts by EOD Thursday (2026-04-23). If Acme needs an encrypted SFTP drop instead of email attachments, we can do that.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Security Programs, Redwood Inference
(attachments to follow: background-check-sample-redacted.pdf, training-completion-roster-2025.csv, onboarding-checklist-v2.pdf, offboarding-playbook-v1.pdf)

Diego / Samira,

I reviewed the redaction sample Diego prepared — looks good from a PII perspective (names redacted, all identifiers removed). HR attests that background checks are performed pre-boarding for all new hires and contractors with access to customer data; exceptions are logged and approved by the People Ops lead.

Notes for Acme: 
- Background checks: performed via SecureScreen (vendor) — we can provide the vendor invoice and policy if that helps.
- Training: mandatory modules include "Security Awareness", "Data Handling & PII", and "Role-based Access"; completion enforced by the LMS with auto-reminders at 30/60/90 days.
- Access gating: identity verification + manager approval + IAM role request.
- Offboarding: access revoked within 2 business days; critical escalations handled same-day.

Drive link for artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OnboardPack_AcmeEvidence

Diego — I'll upload the signed HR attestation and the LMS export to the Drive folder by EOD.

Best,
